newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Living IPO shares, price range lowered.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Living IPO shares, price range lowered.

text.p: The size of an initial public offering of Integrated Living Communities Inc was cut to 5,130,600 shares from 6.53 million, and the estimated price range lowered to $13 to $15 per share from $15 to $18, lead underwriter Smith Barney said Monday.
Integrated Living, a Maryland-based provider of assisted living and other related services, is expected to price and trade the week of September 23, the syndicate department at Smith Barney added.
Integrated Living has applied to trade on Nasdaq under the proposed symbol "ILCC.O."
